evals.name: live-single-decision
evals.prompt: Hva kom NEM til i sak 2021/169 (Psychopharm Young)? Gi meg utfallet og et ordrett sitat fra NEMs vurdering.
evals.expected_output: Looks the decision up live in the cloud without asking about or building a local copy. Finds NEM 2021/169, Legemiddelbehandling av barn og unge med psykiske lidelser i Norge (Psychopharm Young), first instance REK sør-øst D; the outcome as stated in the Vedtak section; at least one verbatim quote labelled as from 'NEMs vurdering'; the forskningsetikk.no URL. May mention once that a local copy adds outcome/keyword facets and phrase search.

evals.name: phrase-search-local-copy
evals.prompt: I'm writing on delayed publication of research results. Which NEM decisions discuss 'utsatt offentlighet', and what did NEM decide in each?
evals.expected_output: Asks whether to keep a local copy (or uses an existing one in a connected folder); sets it up via the local route (on 'no', says the search needs a local copy and offers single-decision lookups instead; never builds a copy in the cloud), runs an exact phrase search and finds the decisions that actually contain the phrase (2013/99 'Klage over avslag på søknad om utsatt offentlighet', 2014/169 'Reindriftas hverdag', 2024/135 'CRUX1', and the 2013/99 ME/CFS decision, as of 2026-10), each with saksnr, title, outcome and URL. Does not report the ~69 loose hits the website's own search gives.

evals.name: facet-filter
evals.prompt: List all NEM decisions where the appeal against REK nord succeeded (medhold) and consent (samtykke) was an issue.
evals.expected_output: Uses the local copy with --forsteinstans 'REK nord', --utfall 'medhold' (stating whether partial medhold is included) and an emneord or text filter for samtykke; lists saksnr, title, exact outcome and URL for each; notes that untagged decisions could be missed by facet filters.
